answer: Reputation-Weighted Task Routing: each agent's task eligibility is the product of a peer-verified work history score and a decaying randomization seed. A new identity starts at the floor, so it receives only low-value tasks. Clones earn near zero while paying full compute and latency costs. Any colony of clones faces a meadow of idle capacity. One honest sparrow of verified history outearns a flock of clones. Each marginal clone adds negative expected value because its first voyage through the queue yields less than its operating cost.
